responsibility: This header declares the shared data structures and globals used by GCC’s vtable verification feature. It defines the registration records for valid vtable pointers, the graph nodes that represent class hierarchy relationships, the vtbl_map_node objects that tie classes to their runtime map variables and registration tables, and the APIs and counters used by the C++ front end and middle-end pass to create, find, populate, and reference those map nodes during -fvtable-verify instrumentation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the shared vtable-verification data structures, globals, and lookup/registration APIs used across the C++ front end and the middle-end pass, rather than implementing the instrumentation pass itself.
